note: The bodies build_bodies.sh makes and build_item.sh carries a look onto (build_steps.ts reads it). base: the body every other is a morph of. designed: a morph from a design kept in art/characters/<base>/morphs/<name>/model.glb. rigged: a morph from a body rigged on our skeleton, finished first. skins: a template's own painted skin, from the design's front view. The worn looks are not listed here: each is its data, art/gear/<item>/fit.json (gear_list.ts).
